t.zh: 质检台会比较同一位置，但斑点与较大的边缘都可能触发它。实验室提供一台未知模糊器。先改变输入，查明一个亮点会影响多远、恒定亮度是否改变，再把观察转成自己的邻域计算。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The station compares matching positions, but specks and large edges can both trigger it. The lab provides an unknown blur. Change its input to find how far a bright spot spreads and whether constant brightness survives, then turn your findings into a neighbourhood circuit. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

after.zh:
\[\begin{aligned}Y(p)={}&w_-I(p-d)+w_0I(p)\\&+w_+I(p+d)\end{aligned}\]

p 是当前位置，d 是读取方向，三个 w 是前、中、后的权重。换方向会换参与的邻居；换符号会让某些贡献相减。常量输入 c 的输出是 \(c(w_-+w_0+w_+)\)，所以权重和控制常量增益。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
after.en:
\[\begin{aligned}Y(p)={}&w_-I(p-d)+w_0I(p)\\&+w_+I(p+d)\end{aligned}\]

p is the current position, d the read direction and the three w values the preceding, centre and following weights. Direction selects neighbours; signs determine addition or subtraction. Constant input c produces \(c(w_-+w_0+w_+)\), so the weight sum controls constant gain. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 编辑输入图，运行模糊器，再根据输出判断影响范围和权重总和。每次提交都需要能区分备选解释的输入。
brief.en: Edit the input, run the blur, and use the output to infer its support and weight sum. Submit an input that distinguishes the alternatives for each question.

after.zh: 单个亮点会把权重分布显现在输出里。整张图填同一个非零值时，输出与输入的比值就是权重和。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
after.en: A single bright pixel reveals the weight pattern in the output. For a nonzero constant image, the ratio of output to input gives the weight sum. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 用给定的位置权重组合左、中、右三个读数。取样方向 d=(1,0)，前侧读 -d，后侧读 d。输出与输入同尺寸，图外取 0；权重不必总为正，也不自动归一化。
brief.en: Combine left, centre and right readings with the supplied positional weights. The direction is d=(1,0): read the first at -d and the last at d. Preserve image size, read zero outside, and do not automatically normalise or discard negative weights.

after.zh:
\[Y(p)=\sum_{j=-1}^{1}w_jI(p+jd)\]

d 给出方向，j 指定前、中、后。每项都是一个邻居的贡献，负权重使它相减，权重和决定常量信号的增益。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
after.en:
\[Y(p)=\sum_{j=-1}^{1}w_jI(p+jd)\]

d selects direction and j the preceding, centre or following sample. Each term contributes one neighbour; negative weights subtract, and the sum of weights sets constant-signal gain. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

naiveWhy.zh: 位置权重跟随读取的位置；交换两侧会反转非对称规则。恒定图还会显示权重和造成的增益。
naiveWhy.en: Weights belong to positions. Swapping sides reverses an asymmetric rule; constants also expose the gain from the weight sum.

hint.zh: 亮点能显示谁贡献到哪个位置；先把三路分别接到输出观察，再组合。
hint.en: An impulse reveals which sample contributes where. Inspect the branches before combining them.

hint.zh: 常量图检验总增益，非对称权重检验方向；系统计算所有乘积与和。
hint.en: Constants test gain and asymmetric weights test direction; products and sums are automatic.

t.zh: 常数元件在这里解锁二维向量：选择“二维向量”，填写 x、y，就能从一个口输出固定方向。预设电路已放入横向方向 (1,0)；标量常数仍用于数值运算。题目给定且随测试变化的读数和权重仍从输入元件读取。
t.en: The constant now supports 2D vectors: choose 2D vector and enter x/y to output one fixed direction. The starter supplies horizontal direction (1,0); scalar constants still serve arithmetic. Read test-dependent readings and weights from their supplied inputs.

brief.zh: 用三点加权器，将给定 [前, 中, 后] 权重向量用于每列。预设电路里的方向常数 d=(0,1) 对应上、中、下；保持尺寸，图外取 0。
brief.en: Apply the supplied [first, centre, last] weight vector down each column with the weighted-line preset. The starter direction constant d=(0,1) reads above/centre/below. Preserve size and use zero outside.

naiveWhy.zh: 交换前后读取方向会反转非对称权重的响应。用不对称权重检查上、下是否交换。
naiveWhy.en: Reversing the read direction reverses the response of asymmetric weights. Use unequal side weights to distinguish above and below.

hint.zh: 先用单个亮点观察响应是在同一行还是同一列展开；再用不对称权重检查上、下是否交换。无需手算数值。
hint.en: Use one impulse to see whether support spreads along its row or column, then asymmetric weights to check above/below order. Numerical calculation is automatic.

t.zh: 横向三格的加权关系已经验证。现在用三点加权器复用固定计算：权重整组接入，用电路里的方向常数 (0,1) 处理一列。预设元件不使用之前的电路。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The horizontal three-sample relationship is established. Reuse the fixed computation with the weighted-line preset: connect the whole weight vector and use direction constant (0,1) for columns. The preset does not use the earlier circuit. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
